title: The locally invertible open of a module morphism
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\varphi:M\to N$ a morphism of $\mathcal O_W$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $U_\varphi$ as the union of all open subsets $V\subseteq W$ for which $\iota_V^*\varphi$ is an isomorphism, where $\iota_V:V\to W$ is the open subscheme inclusion [def-weil-open-immersion] and pullback is tensor-formula pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Thus $x\in U_\varphi$ exactly when such a $V$ contains $x$.
